AC Error? We Have the Solution

Modern ACs often display error codes. While some indicate simple issues you might fix, many require professional attention. A faulty installation can often be the root cause. Here are some common codes:

Error E1/F1: Sensor Fault

This often points to a room temperature sensor failure. It might be a loose connection, but could also be a faulty sensor needing replacement.

Error E4: Communication Error

Indicates a problem with the communication between the indoor and outdoor units. This is often due to incorrect wiring during ac fitting.

Error P0: Inverter Module Protection

Can be caused by low voltage or a compressor issue. A professional needs to diagnose the exact cause to prevent further damage.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What are the charges for a new split AC installation?

Our split ac installation charges are very competitive, starting from ₹1499. This includes standard installation of the indoor and outdoor units, but excludes extra copper piping, wall stands, or any core cutting work if required. You can find a detailed ac installation price list on our page.

How quickly can you install my new AC?

We pride ourselves on providing prompt service. We offer same day ac installation in Ahmedabad and other major cities, subject to booking time and availability. For most locations like Vadodara, Surat, and Rajkot, we aim for installation within 24 hours.

Do you provide a guarantee on the installation service?

Yes, absolutely! We provide a 3-month guarantee on our split ac installation service. This covers any issues arising from the installation work itself, such as gas leaks from the joints we’ve made. Your peace of mind is our priority.

Do you serve my area in Vadodara?

Yes, we serve all areas of Vadodara. Whether you need split ac installation service in Alkapuri, ac fitting in Nizampura, or ac installation service in Akota, our technicians are ready to help. We cover Manjalpur, Gotri, Waghodia Road, Vasna Bhayli Road, Karelibaug, and all other localities.

What is included in the standard split AC installation?

A standard split ac fitting includes mounting the indoor unit on the wall, placing the outdoor unit, connecting both units with up to 10 feet of copper pipe and electrical wire provided with the AC, ensuring proper drainage, and performing a functional check.

Why is professional AC installation important?

Professional air conditioner installation is crucial for optimal performance, energy efficiency, and the longevity of your unit. A trained technician ensures correct refrigerant levels, secure mounting, and proper electrical connections, preventing potential hazards and costly future repairs.
